about.title: We are a specialised <accent>institution</accent> for the letterform
about.lead: We launched in 2022 to establish the authentic methodology of Arabic calligraphy. We do not run quick courses — we offer a long-term academic journey whose goal is to forge a true, qualified calligrapher.

vision.title: We go beyond the letter
vision.body: We pass on the essentials of years of practice: posture, grip, paper and ink, visual memory, and self-critique.

boundless.title: We teach without borders
boundless.body: We harness online teaching to break geography, save students travel, and turn every minute into real practice.

mastery.title: We pick mastery from its source
mastery.body: We restrict teaching to a chosen elite of internationally awarded masters with certified ijazat — no compromises on craft.

methodology.title: We progress step by step, the <accent>Mashq</accent> way
methodology.highlight: Our method is built on repetition.
methodology.highlightSub: Progress to the next lesson is by mastery, not by repetition count.

mechanism.title: Pick <accent>your way</accent> to learn
mechanism.subtitle: Four tracks covering every level — from first stroke to mastery.

recorded.title: Traditional Correction
recorded.summary: The traditional Mashq system, long-term, with your dedicated master.
recorded.audience: The serious student aiming for true mastery — patient, committed, and looking for a structured long-term path.
recorded.duration: Two to three years, longer or shorter based on your dedication and pace.
details: Four lessons per month — one per week, sent by email.
Get your correction back as a video + image on your private Drive.
Curated practice and email reminders to stay on track.

live.title: Live Correction
live.summary: One-on-one live Zoom sessions with your teacher.
live.audience: The student who prefers writing live in front of a master with open dialogue around every detail.
live.duration: Two to three years depending on your progress.
details: Weekly live Zoom session at a fixed time.
Lesson correction at the start of the session, followed by live explanation of new segments. Session length: 1–1.5 hours.
Posture, grip, and rhythm tuned under immediate supervision.

intensive.title: Group Intensive Courses
intensive.summary: Maximum content in the shortest time.
intensive.audience: Intermediate students wanting maximum information in the shortest possible window.
details: Hybrid system: live group Zoom explanation for everyone.
Private recorded correction for each student individually.
An ideal warm-up before joining the long-term core programme.

foundation.title: Beginners' Foundation
foundation.summary: Discover the world of calligraphy and learn the basics.
foundation.audience: Total beginners who never studied with a master and want a clean, structured start.
details: Private recorded correction for each student.
Introduction to pens, papers, inks; correct posture and grip.

features.title: What makes your experience here <accent>exceptional</accent>?
features.subtitle: Small details that make the big difference — included with every membership.

community.title: Exclusive interactive student community
community.body: Daily discussion, peer reviews, and student-to-student support in a private space.

tips.title: Golden tips from masters
tips.body: Wisdom drawn from decades of practice — from grip to the secrets of harakat.

feeding.title: Rare visual feeding
feeding.body: Curated artworks and manuscripts that build your visual memory daily.

qa.title: Monthly live Q&A
qa.body: A direct meet with all teachers: calligraphy, its etiquette, its stories, and your questions.

feedback.title: We listen deeply
feedback.body: We act on every piece of feedback — our experience evolves with our students.

features.communityCaption: Glimpses from the exclusive student community
